player_prompt.intro:
Am ạmi Player {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ṭhakurạy ṭiṅ {num_rounds} ṭhuruy reḷe.

Khela ṭhakurạy:
- Sạbhnạ ṭhuruy ṭiṅ ạmi {total_conversation_rounds} ṭhuruy ṭiṅ katha kạmi ṭhurạy.
- Ṭhakurạy ṭiṅ, ṭhuruy ṭiṅ ṭhuruy ṭhakurạy ṭiṅ cooperate ṭhuruy defect ṭhuruy ṭhurạy.

Payoff Matrix (ṭiṅ ṭhuruy ṭhakurạy):
- Ṭhuruy Cooperate ➜ ṭiṅ {cooperate_reward}
- Ṭhuruy Defect ➜ ṭiṅ {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ṭhuruy Ṭiṅ Defects, Ṭhuruy Ṭiṅ Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Khela ṭhurạy:
- Katha kạmi ṭhuruy: ạmi katha kạmi ṭhurạy.
- Ṭhuruy ṭhakurạy ṭiṅ: '[Cooperate]' ṭhuruy '[Defect]' ṭhuruy ṭhurạy (case-insensitive). Ạmi katha kạmi ṭhuruy ṭiṅ ṭhuruy ṭhuruy ṭhuruy ṭhurạy.

phases.conversation_finished: Katha kạmi ṭhuruy ṭiṅ ṭhuruy {round}. '[Cooperate]' ṭhuruy '[Defect]' ṭhuruy ṭhuruy \boxed{{}} ṭhuruy ṭhurạy.
